comment: There are some aspects that I like about B, but it also doesn't look too natural. the leftmost peak has weird artifacts at the top. Then there is just one super sharp peak. I think a more natural landscape would have repeated features but those features vary alot between biomes/areas. Here you have a bunch of different interesting features but they are all in the same place and too different together. Not sure if this makes sense. Not really sure this is the issue, just trying to understand why it looks weird to me
